key_insight: DPA4C-LR combines long-range electrostatics with local learned-charge derivatives to enable scalable atomistic simulations with electrical response.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports large-scale modeling of field-responsive materials, ionic conductors, and thermal interfaces toward device-relevant length scales.
method: Separate electrostatic forces and Born effective charges into global electrostatics and strictly local learned-charge derivatives.
Preserve spatial decomposition for distributed evaluation of energies, forces, stresses, and electrical response.
Implement DPA4C-LR on nvalchemi with support for different electrostatic boundary conditions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 5.2 million atoms on four GPUs at approximately twice the short-range backbone cost, alongside demonstrations of water infrared spectra, relaxor hysteresis, ionic conductivity, and interfacial thermal transport.
watch_item: Global electrostatics still requires coordinated computation, and the reported four-GPU result does not establish scaling efficiency on larger GPU counts.
paper_title: Scalable long-range machine learning interatomic potentials with electrical response for atomistic material modeling
